feed_step_1: Switch the track off and unplug the transformer.
feed_step_2: Start: push the brass tabs of cable {{cable}} from below into the connection track (piece 1, start/finish).
feed_step_3: Route the cable underneath the track to piece {{piece}} ({{at}} m after start/finish) – never across the lanes.
feed_step_4: End: push the tabs from below into standard straight no. {{piece}} in the same way.
feed_step_5: Important: at both ends each wire must sit on the same rail (same position in driving direction). Swapped wires can cause a short circuit.
feed_step_6: Switch on and test: cars should no longer slow down here and switches should work reliably.
